card.name: Partway through det- words and waiting for effect
card.fires_on: Mostly the 'det' or 'eter' piece inside words like detachment, detrusor and deterioration. Also words just before 'take effect' or 'taken effect' after a numbing agent or poison.

modes.label: Inside det- words
modes.description: The 'Det', 'det' or 'eter' piece at the start of detachment, detrusor or deterioration, often in section headings.

modes.label: Waiting for effect to start
modes.description: A word right before 'take effect' or 'take hold', after an anesthetic or poison.
modes.example: wait for the local anesthetic<< to>> take effect

card.plain: It lights up inside words like detachment and deterioration, and when a text says to wait for a numbing drug to work.
